Build what's next in good company.

Future Unicorn Founders hosts networking gatherings in Málaga for founders, builders, investors and professionals. Meet peers, talk through real business challenges—from growth and strategy to ideas still taking shape—and build connections that can continue beyond the event.

Explore gatherings

Málaga, Spain
International in outlook. Connected to Málaga.

Málaga brings together an international business community and a relaxed Mediterranean pace. We welcome people who live here, and founders, investors and professionals visiting the city.

Ambitious, but approachable.

Big ideas matter. So do the people behind them.

You don't need an impressive title or a polished pitch to belong. Bring your experience, your curiosity or a challenge you're thinking through. There's room for an honest conversation at every stage.
